title: One PDF/A-3 that is the invoice's page and its XML: Factur-X and ZUGFeRD 2
source: Factur-X 1.0 (current release 1.09.2, with ZUGFeRD 2.5.2, 4 August 2026, fnfe-mpe.org and ferd-net.de): the hybrid invoice, a PDF/A-3 carrying the Cross Industry Invoice as factur-x.xml (xrechnung.xml for the XRECHNUNG profile of ZUGFeRD 2.x), with XMP naming DocumentType, DocumentFileName, Version and ConformanceLevel in urn:factur-x:pdfa:CrossIndustryDocument:invoice:1p0#. FNFE-MPE calls Factur-X one of the three formats of the French reform's minimum base. Read 2026-10-09.

rules.text: The PDF carries the invoice XML as factur-x.xml (xrechnung.xml), listed in /AF with an AFRelationship, with XMP declaring PDF/A-3 and the Factur-X level the XML's guideline ID names, and the XML inside is the XML beside it.
veraPDF finds the PDF compliant with PDF/A-3B; skipped when veraPDF is not installed.
